run_audio_classification_pipeline_test: run the audio classification pipeline test with a small wav2vec2 model and numpy audio input
test_audio_classification_fp16: test the audio classification pipeline with float16 dtype on a small wav2vec2 model
test_audio_classification_large_model: test the audio classification pipeline with a large superb wav2vec2 model on real speech data
test_audio_classification_top_k_none: test that top_k=None returns all labels from the audio classification pipeline model
test_audio_classification_top_k_capping: test that top_k greater than label count is capped to the number of labels
